Show the robot the task you want automated. No code, no engineers, no integration project. Just demonstrate.

Once reliable, deploy additional units across your facility. Scale without proportional overhead.
We’re a small team, building robots to automate how the world's goods are moved. We love the craft of building a real physical product from nothing, and seeing it doing useful work.
We're proud to be backed by some of the world's best investors, founders and AI researchers.
